about: Real storefronts near Công viên Tượng đài Chiến thắng Long Khánh. A storefront is drawn in the scene only when its position was resolved from a map pin. Scene frame: +x = south (toward the park tip), +z = west (QL1 side); the park centre is near x = 10, z = 0; 1 unit = 1 m.

imagery.file: maps/satellite_context.jpg (from the reference bundle; not published)
imagery.source: Esri World Imagery (Vantor), capture date 2025-02-05, EPSG:3857, 0.597 m/px
imagery.note: Imagery shows roofs, not signs. It was used to measure the offset between the pin and the monument, not to identify the shop.

stores.name: Highlands Coffee
stores.address: 239 Hùng Vương, phường Xuân Hòa (khu phố 5), Long Khánh, Đồng Nai
address_evidence: diadiemlongkhanh.com listing: 239 Hùng Vương, described as facing the view of the monument
bank/partner store lists (VPBank, VRBank, GotIt) giving the same address
Đồng Nai TV coverage placing the shop at the Victory Monument

coordinates.source: map pin embedded in the diadiemlongkhanh.com listing
coordinates.accuracy: directory pin, not surveyed; treat as +/- 15 m

reference_point.name: monument POI
reference_point.source: tanitour.com POI; not a surveyed centre

scene_estimate.meaning: across Hùng Vương from the middle of the park, on the corner just north of a side-street mouth

stores.placement: The 'HIGHLANDS COFFEE' shop sign is put on the generated shophouse nearest the estimate (within 12 m; the test run found it about 3 m away). Plain text sign only, no logo. An info prompt at the door says the location is approximate.
stores.facade_evidence: none used. No photo of this storefront was available, so the building is the generic stylised shophouse; width, height, colours and signage layout are NOT verified.

stores.name: Sacombank (PGD Long Khánh area)
stores.address: 259 Hùng Vương, khu phố 5, phường Xuân Hòa, Long Khánh, Đồng Nai
address_evidence: Sacombank relocation notice (2019) carried by kisvn.vn / vietstock.vn: '259 Hung Vuong, area 5, Xuan Hoa Ward'
thebank.vn branch listing with the same address
stores.reason_pending: No map pin or other coordinate source was found. House numbers on this stretch are not on the imagery, so the parcel could not be picked by counting from 239. Not placed, to avoid putting a real bank on the wrong building.
stores.to_resolve: A Google Maps / OpenStreetMap pin, or a street-level photo showing the bank next to a known landmark.
